title: fix(cli): os migrate boots a stack that declares queues and assignment rules
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbTGhxJSYAmQXU7efVdNqrpw)_

Fixes #33608

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`os migrate` 的一次性启动(`bootSchemaStack`)在组合里没有 sharing 提供方时,只注册 `ownership-queue` 服务本身;不加 sharing 对象,不启用任何 sharing 运行时。
- 为什么改:声明了队列和分配规则的应用(HotCRM)跑 `os migrate summary-nulls` 等数据迁移时启动即被拒,汇总字段补数做不了。
- 风险与回滚:只影响一次性迁移启动;已带 sharing 的 `plan`/`apply` 组合不变,表集合不变。回滚即还原本 PR 的 `schema-migrate.ts` 那一段。
- 先看:`packages/cli/src/utils/migrate-ownership-queue.ts`(只注册服务的那段)、`packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.ts` 新增的 15 行、集成测试 `summary-nulls.ownership-queue.integration.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration src/commands/migrate/summary-nulls.ownership-queue.integration.test.ts`,预期 5 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ObjectQLPlugin` refuses, at `kernel:ready`, a stack that declares `queues` or `assignmentRules` when no `ownership-queue` service is registered (`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` `assertOwnershipQueueServicePresent`, message from `describeMissingOwnershipQueueService` in `packages/objectql/src/assignment-rules.ts`). `os serve` passes because `sharing` is on `PLATFORM_ALWAYS_ON_CAPABILITIES` and `SharingServicePlugin.init()` registers the service. Every `os migrate` subcommand that boots the stack goes through `bootSchemaStack` (`packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.ts`). Only the served-platform composition (`plan`, `apply`, `unmapped-columns`, `organization-ownership`, `stored-references`) carries the sharing provider. The plain data stack, the `buildDataMigrationPlugins` set and the host-only composition did not, so on a queue-using app every other subcommand refused to boot.

`bootSchemaStack` now adds one small plugin after the composition and the extra plugins, unless one of them already provides `sharing` (judged by `providesCapability` on the `sharing` row of `CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS`). Its `init()` registers an `OwnershipQueueService` (the class `SharingServicePlugin` registers) under `OWNERSHIP_QUEUE_SERVICE`, reaching the engine at use. It does nothing else: it declares no manifest, so there are no sharing objects, and it has no `start()` and binds no hook.

The service alone is used rather than `composeProviderForDeclarations(new SharingServicePlugin())`. That route was measured first: its `init()` also declares the sharing objects. Every one-shot boot then examined more tables, and `schema-migrate.host-composition.integration.test.ts` › "still examines exactly the data-stack tables and composes nothing" and `data-commands.absent-database.integration.test.ts` › "value-shapes --json walks the stored record, exit 0" went red. An `--apply` boot would also have created any missing sharing tables, which is DDL the operator never saw in the preview.

Every `os migrate` subcommand that boots, and how it boots:

| Subcommands | Composition | Before | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| `summary-nulls`, `value-shapes`, `recorded-by`, `resume`, `option-codes`, `blank-single-values`, `blank-multi-values`, `text-scalars`, `stored-expressions`, `record-currency-codes`, `recompute-home-amounts`, `files-to-references`, `meta --stored`, `activity-changed-fields`, `comment-parent-pair`, `comment-reactions`, `audit-key-material`, `audit-mail-bodies`, `audit-metadata-bodies`, `audit-side-copies` | `buildDataMigrationPlugins` | refused | service registered |
| `account-issuer`, `duplicates`, `multi-value-columns` | plain data stack | refused | service registered |
| `packageless-overlays`, `security-catalog-overlays` | host composition | refused | service registered |
| `plan` (and bare `os migrate`), `apply`, `unmapped-columns`, `organization-ownership`, `stored-references`, `stored-references bind` | served platform (sharing composed) | booted | unchanged; no second registration |
| `meta` without `--stored` | boots nothing | n/a | n/a |

The other `bootSchemaStack` callers (`audit verify`, `db orphans`, `storage orphans`, `secret orphans` / `rewrap`, `plugin trust *`) get the same fix through the same helper.

## Tests

- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/summary-nulls.ownership-queue.integration.test.ts` (new, integration tier). The fixture app has one queue, one assignment rule and two roll-ups (`count`, `sum`) over a master-detail child, with rows written below the engine's door so the roll-ups are `NULL`. `os migrate summary-nulls` runs through oclif: the dry run counts 4 `NULL` values and writes none, `--apply` fills them (`2 / 42` and `0 / 0`), and a re-run reads 0. Each of the four compositions boots with the service registered as an `OwnershipQueueService`, with no `sharing` service, and with `sys_queue` registered only where the served platform declares it.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/migrate-ownership-queue.test.ts` (new, unit). `init()` registers exactly `OWNERSHIP_QUEUE_SERVICE` as an `OwnershipQueueService`, binds no hook and reads no service, and the plugin has no `start()`. A composition that already holds the provider (a host config's own instance) gets nothing. For the declaration-composed instance that `plan` / `apply` mount, the pin is the served-platform case of the integration test: a second registration would throw there.

## Acceptance notes

- On this boot the service answers from the declarations. Its authored reads (`sys_queue`, `sys_queue_member`) fail, because those objects are not registered here. It warns once and answers from the declarations alone. Only the engine's assignment step reaches it, on an INSERT into an object with assignment rules. An update never evaluates a rule, so `summary-nulls` routes nothing.

## Verification

All readings below are on `5878b6074` unless a line names another head. `6738e859e` is the merge of `origin/main`, and the two commits after it change only the two new test files (a type cast, and module-top imports for `check:test-source-alias`).

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0, including `check:test-typecheck: OK`.
- `vitest run` on the two new files plus `test/vitest-tiers-partition.test.ts`: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 29 passed (29)`. The new integration file is classified in the integration tier.
- Full cli unit tier at `6738e859e`: `Test Files 422 passed (422)`, `Tests 6003 passed (6003)`.
- Full cli integration tier at `6738e859e`: `Test Files 222 passed | 2 skipped (224)`, `Tests 2021 passed | 10 skipped (2031)`. This diff changes the one-shot boot path, so the integration tier was run locally.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each mutation landed through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; each was restored, and git diff HEAD was empty afterwards)</summary>

- `bootSchemaStack` never uses the provider (`if (ownershipQueueProvider && process.env.OS_ABLATION_NEVER)`): the integration file goes red in its fixture boot with the card's refusal, `[ObjectQLPlugin] the stack declares queues (1) and assignmentRules (1), but no 'ownership-queue' service is registered …`, and `Tests 5 skipped`. This is the reproduction of the card.
- The already-composed guard is disabled: the unit case goes red with `expected SharingServicePlugin{ …(8) } to be null`. The integration served-platform case goes red with `[Kernel] Service 'ownership-queue' already registered`, which also shows that the served-platform composition registered the service before this change. Result: `Tests 3 failed | 5 passed (8)`.
- The first design composed the provider with `composeProviderForDeclarations(new SharingServicePlugin())`. With that wrapper removed, the unit case went red because the provider's hook was called (`expected "vi.fn()" to not be called at all`). The integration tier showed why that design was dropped: `schema-migrate.host-composition.integration.test.ts` › "still examines exactly the data-stack tables and composes nothing" and `data-commands.absent-database.integration.test.ts` › "value-shapes --json walks the stored record, exit 0" both went red.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` gave 68 commands at `6738e859e`. All 68 were run, and 64 exited 0.
- `check:test-source-alias` was red (exit 1) on both new test files. They now import at module top, and the gate is OK at `5878b6074`.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: NOT MEASURED (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET). It needs every package built; CI builds them.
- `check:i18n-coverage`: NOT MEASURED (exit 3). This was a partial lint round, so nothing was compared.
- `check:type-check-debt`: the sweep's run was NOT MEASURED because it got no turn on the verify lock. Re-run under the lock at `5878b6074`: exit 0, `check-type-check-coverage --re-measure: OK — 0 ledger entr(ies) re-measured … none above its recorded number`.
- Re-run at `5878b6074` after the test-file commits, all exit 0: `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:tier-file-adoption`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:startup-registry-verdict`, `check:type-check-coverage`.
- PR-body gates on this body, all exit 0: `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`, `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-closing-keyword-parity`, `check-partof-closing-keyword`.
